comparison.objective: Press-rinse a glass and leave it rim-down on a drain mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Invert and center a glass, apply controlled downward force, then transfer and release it.
comparison.success_condition: Required rinse dwell plus stable rim-down placement; uncovered activation or excessive tilt scores zero.
comparison.reason: Push-down fixture operation and single-vessel handling do not test separating mixed free bodies through apertures.
